rule: A type alias (`using X = T;`, `typedef T X;`, Zig `const X = a.b.T`) is expanded to its target, so the ID names the real type (`std.map#begin`, not `SafeStringMap#begin`); a declared type resolves through the file's using-directives and using-declarations, including those of headers it includes. **C++**: namespace-qualified with dots: `ns.Class#method`, `ns.func`; `Class::static()` → `Class#static`; template arguments dropped. Free function: its name (with the language's module qualifier where it has one).
source: KNOWN_GAP: cpp: function-local typedefs and namespace-member calls (DirectX::XM…) are under-resolved
notes: 'typedef Counter C;' is a function-local alias; SPEC expands every type alias to its target, so c (declared C*) names scene.Counter → scene.Counter#inc / #get, high (pointer reaches the pointee). DirectX::XMVectorAdd / XMVectorScale are namespace-member free functions with inline bodies in the scanned header dxmath.h → ns.func form 'DirectX.XMVectorAdd', direct, high, from scene.cpp and from inside the header (C1: one ID). The local 'using Vec = DirectX::XMVECTOR' and the copy-initialisation of r from a call result are not calls; static_cast is a cast.
